refund-window.md: Refunds are issued within fourteen days of the return being received. The window begins when the warehouse scans the parcel, not when it is posted.
damaged-goods.md: Items that arrive broken qualify for a replacement at no cost. Send a photograph with the claim.
express-fees.md: Shipping surcharges for next-day service are returned separately from the item price.
late-claims.md: Claims raised more than ninety days after purchase are declined without exception.
order-lookup.md: Every purchase is assigned an identifier such as 48812. Quote it in all correspondence.
escalation.md: Tickets that remain unresolved after two working days are passed to a senior engineer.
export-errors.md: If the export button returns a server error, clear the cache and retry once before raising a ticket.
account-tiers.md: Business customers receive priority handling. Personal accounts follow the standard queue.
